The `Badge` component's `tone` prop doesn't accept `"enabled"` - it needs `"new"` or `"attention"` for the neutral-ish tones. But the error is that `{testResult.confidence}% confidence` — the Badge children is a template literal expression mixing number and string. The issue is that `{testResult.confidence}% confidence` is JSX content inside Badge that TypeScript sees as a number (`testResult.confidence`) being passed where string is expected. Let me check the exact Polaris Badge children type — actually the issue is that `Badge` children expects `React.ReactNode`, and `{testResult.confidence}% confidence` is a template literal. In JSX, `{testResult.confidence}% confidence` is parsed as `{testResult.confidence}` (number expression) followed by `% confidence` (text). The Badge component likely has a children type of `string` not `ReactNode`.

- `<s-text color="subdued">` → `<Text ... tone="subdued">`
- `<s-badge>` → `<Badge>`
- `<s-button>` → `<Button>` (with `url` instead of `href`)
- `<s-button-group>` → `<ButtonGroup>`
- `<s-banner>` → `<Banner title="...">` (not `heading`)
- `<s-divider>` → `<Divider />`
- `<s-switch>` → `<Checkbox>` with Polaris `onChange={(checked) => fn(checked)}` pattern
- `<s-select>` + `<s-option>` → `<Select options={[...]}>`
- `<s-text-field>` → `<TextField autoComplete="off">`
- `<s-text-area>` → `<TextField multiline={6} autoComplete="off">`
- `<s-number-field>` → `<TextField type="number">`
- `<s-link>` → `<Button variant="plain" url="...">`
- `<s-unordered-list>` + `<s-list-item>` → `<List>` + `<List.Item>`
- `<s-clickable>` → `<div onClick style={{cursor:"pointer"}}>`
- Selectable cards (AlgorithmCard, FitCard) → `<div>` wrapper with conditional `outline` style + `<Card>`
- Responsive grids → `<InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 3 }} gap="400">`
- All event handlers updated to Polaris pattern (no `(e: Event) => e.target` casting)
- `useNavigate` added for `backAction`
